subject: Re: lavaan WARNING: syntax contains parameters involving exogenous covariates; switching to fixed.x = FALSE

messages.author: 12fdd832cacb825e
messages.subject: Re: lavaan WARNING: syntax contains parameters involving exogenous covariates; switching to fixed.x = FALSE
parts:
Typically in SEM, exogenous variables are treated differently in the estimation process from endogenous variables. By explicity specifying their covariances, you are "bringing them into" the model and lavaan treats them in the same way as it does endogenous variables. So the usual practice is not to have a section like "# Exogenous predictors correlations." It's also usually not necessary--all exogenous covariables are free to covary by default.

However, before that section, you have this:
beta ~~ SizeInvDis.3   + SizeInvDis.9   + SizeInvDis.15   + SizeInvDis.21   +
        Breastfed.3    + Breastfed.9    + Breastfed.15    + Breastfed.21    +
        ChildHealth.3  + ChildHealth.9  + ChildHealth.15  + ChildHealth.21  +
        FS.score.0     + FS.score.6     + FS.score.12     + FS.score.18     +
        MotherHealth.0 + MotherHealth.6 + MotherHealth.12 + MotherHealth.18 +
        LnExpenditure.0   

Which brings them into the model. It also has causes of the indicators of beta correlate with beta--is that what you want? If it is, then yes, you do need that other section, and the warning is letting you know lavaan adapted appropriately to your specification--note that is a warning, not an error. Was the model identified?

Pat
